jobs.name: A2_天气屋_坡地展开_彩色概念
jobs.detail: Select A2, the MIDDLE panel. Keep the cottage on the left third on an open diagonal grassy shoulder, the leaning old tree behind it, the route arriving from the right, broad open sky and the nearby pond suggested in the distance. jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a complete FULL-COLOR 2D environment concept painting for the cozy third-person game "Weather House", developed from one approved black-and-white composition.
Input image role: the supplied three-panel grayscale board is a COMPOSITION REFERENCE / EDIT TARGET. Select ONLY the explicitly named panel. Output ONE standalone wide 16:9 painting of that panel, not a sheet, not three panels. Preserve that panel's viewpoint, horizon, major silhouettes, focal placement, walkable space and connected light-dark masses.
Art direction: designed, graphic, hand-painted environment visual development. Expressive asymmetric silhouettes, clear large local-color shapes, selective opaque gouache-like brush strokes, simple designed shadow shapes, flat matte surfaces. About 70 percent of the scene remains quiet broad color masses, with selective designed edges and a few descriptive accents around the focal area. Refine shapes and storytelling rather than filling everything with detail. Clear perspective and depth through overlap, scale and atmospheric color, with deliberately compressed tonal modeling. A beautiful complete CONCEPT PAINTING with strong economy, not a polished 3D render, not a photograph given a painterly filter.
Shared world: a small cream plaster and timber cottage with a broad slightly crooked moss/sage-green roof, round window and simple porch; leaning old trees; rounded friendly woodland animals. The little witch, where visible in the selected composition, is a small 3.5–4-head-tall girl with a chestnut bob, muted teal floppy witch hat and short cape, cream tunic, brown boots and a simple wooden wand. Keep her small enough for the environment to dominate.
Shared palette: restrained yellow-green grass, sage and olive foliage, cool gray-blue or teal shadow masses, cream highlights, warm gray angular stone planes, pale cyan sky and broad off-white cloud shapes when sky is visible. Only a few small white/yellow/blue flower accents. Canopies are broad painted shapes, not individual leaves; grass is broad fields, not blade-by-blade rendering. Rocks use two or three designed planes. Timber uses shape and color, not detailed grain. Mood is quiet, approachable, lived-in fairy tale.
Weather rule: weather belongs to an area. No low floating mini cloud above an animal or prop, no narrow isolated shower, no weather-icon cloud. Rainy views use broad natural overcast sky above trees, rain across landscape depth, and sparse simple wet-ground reflections.
Avoid: photorealism, game screenshot appearance, PBR, glossy materials, ambient-occlusion creases, smooth 3D volume modeling, lens effects, depth-of-field blur, excessive sun shafts, detailed grass/leaves/bark/roof tiles, tiny highlights everywhere, heavy black outlines, neon, excessive saturation, impasto texture overlay, added monuments or buildings. No text, panel numbers, border, watermark or collage.
Selected panel: A2 (middle of the supplied board).
Select A2, the MIDDLE panel. Keep the cottage on the left third on an open diagonal grassy shoulder, the leaning old tree behind it, the route arriving from the right, broad open sky and the nearby pond suggested in the distance. Use an airy clear morning with soft cream light on the wall and broad cool shadow beneath the eaves. The left cottage/tree cluster is the designed focal mass; leave the right sky and hillside spacious. A few grasses or a short fence may clarify scale without clutter. The broad crooked roof and branch rhythm should have personality. Do not introduce a foreground tree arch from A1 or the water-dominant composition from A3.

jobs.name: A3_天气屋_隔塘望屋_彩色概念
jobs.detail: Select A3, the BOTTOM panel. Preserve the quiet small pond across the lower foreground, stepping-stone approach hugging the left bank, cottage on the far middle-right bank and large crooked old tree beside it. Keep the foreground reeds as a few dark graphic shapes. Water is a broad pale turquoise shape with broken horizontal reflection strokes, not a realistic mirror. Warm cream cottage walls and moss-green roof sit against cool foliage. A quiet clear period after rain, warm soft afternoon illumination. Preserve the intimate scale of a pond beside the home. Do not turn it into a lake or add a big bridge. No added foreground heroine is needed if absent from the selected sketch.

jobs.name: B2_树屋小院_俯看需求空间_彩色概念
jobs.detail: Select B2, the MIDDLE panel. Preserve the slightly elevated three-quarter view of the whole little courtyard: squirrel hollow in the large tree above center, twig drying rack with a few hanging leaves at left, frog's moss bed and leaned leaf umbrella at right, tiny witch entering from lower right, open wet ground connecting both. Rounded squirrel and frog, no clothing. This is gentle widespread rainy weather before repair: the entire clearing and background forest are under natural overcast, with sparing rain strokes over the entire scene, paler low-contrast distant tree shapes and broad muted wet-ground patches. No separate hanging cloud, no localized column of rain, no sunny island. Use cool muted blue-green surroundings and warmer wood/leaf accents to keep cozy readability. Keep the terrain walkable and flat enough between request stations.

jobs.name: 地图01_紧凑环线
jobs.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: SIMPLE OVERHEAD TERRAIN AND LEVEL-LAYOUT CONCEPT MAP for a small third-person woodland game "Weather House". This is a clean practical terrain-blockout planning drawing, not a decorative world map or finished painting.
Deliverable: ONE square TRUE TOP-DOWN orthographic map. All roofs and canopies are seen directly from above. No perspective, no isometric tilt, no horizon. Four functional areas labeled exactly A, B, C, D once each in clean bold dark lettering placed on or beside their area. No other text, numbers, title, compass, scale, UI, border or legends.
Shared level contents: A is one small weather cottage with a nearby large tree and entry clearing; B is one old tree hollow courtyard with a tiny drying rack and moss bed; C is a small pond with an accessible bank clearing; D is a modest grassy hill crest with a small simple wind-chime post. One instance of each area only. A and B should feel neighboring. The level is a compact forest neighborhood. Tiny structure footprints, not illustrated facades or characters.
Visual language: very simple flat diagram, crisp slightly hand-drawn edges, generous empty walkable ground. Sage-green background terrain, light warm beige walkable clearings, muted darker green tree-canopy clusters, pale blue water, a slightly lighter ochre/sage patch for raised ground with only 2–3 thin contour lines. The main walkable route is a continuous broad cream/tan path with consistent readable width. Each clearing is visibly wider than its connecting path. Small gray angular blocks for occasional rocks only. Keep wooded boundaries coherent, canopy clusters sparse around the route. Avoid individual leaf textures, shadows, relief shading, painterly noise, dense props, buildings other than A, bridge clutter, icons floating above terrain or tiny labels.
Functional requirements: all A/B/C/D areas are connected on traversable land. Natural gentle slopes lead to D; no sheer cliff on a required route. Do not send a route through deep water. Provide a legible A-to-B-to-C-to-D journey and a return connection to A. Woods and low rocky/raised edges should define the outer boundary. Each option is a plausible entire level, not an asset sheet. Map is schematic for comparing terrain and circulation; do not add precise dimensions. Readable at a glance, only a handful of large shapes.
Layout option 1: COMPACT FOUR-CLEARING LOOP. A in lower-left beside the entry at bottom; B in upper-left sheltered by a large old tree; C small pond in upper-right with clearing on its southern/western dry bank; D grassy raised shoulder in lower-right. A broad rounded loop path connects A -> B -> C bank -> D -> A. Pond sits inside its northeastern corner without blocking the route. A narrow crescent of raised ground only along the right/east edge with sparse contour marks. Central space is low grass with a few sparse trees and a clear sightline diagonally from D back to A. Dense outer forest edge, especially north and west, shapes a single compact gardenlike level. Clear A/B adjacency and short return D/A. Main design should look like a loose rectangle loop, not a radial hub.
